description.narrative: The objective of the assignment is to complete the formulation of a new strategic framework for an initiative supporting civil society to Strengthening and Protecting Inclusive Democratic Space into a relevant, effective and efficient programme. • The timeframe for the overall initiative/programme will be 2023-2026 • The overall financial framework for Digital Democracy Initiative activities are expected to be 50 million DKK per year 2023-2026 (200 million DKK in total). • This initiative should build on the Danish Development Strategy, The World We Share.
